question: May the LongCat provider import and forward every longcat.chat cookie because the service's minimal authentication cookie is undocumented?
rationale: Tests can validate request handling, but they cannot decide whether the repository should accept this credential scope or demonstrate that the live service requires it.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the complete same-origin cookie header only after redacted current-head proof and clear user-facing disclosure of the credential scope.

options.title: Require a minimal cookie set
options.body: Block merge until the implementation identifies and forwards only the cookies required for LongCat quota access.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Defer the integration until LongCat offers a documented usage API or a narrower stable authentication mechanism.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the complete same-origin cookie header only after redacted current-head proof and clear user-facing disclosure of the credential scope.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and provider architecture decision owner, steipete is the best available person to approve a new browser-cookie credential boundary.
